clusters.label: Thinks summer happens because Earth is closer to the Sun
clusters.why_it_matters: Survives into adulthood; blocks any later understanding of seasons or climate.
quotes: Because the earth moves nearer to the sun in June
The earth is closer to the sun during summer

reteach.title: Same distance, different tilt
steps: Demonstrate axial tilt with a globe.
Ask: if distance caused summer, why winter in Sydney now?
reteach.check_question: If distance caused summer, why is it winter in Sydney right now?

clusters.diagnostic_question: Explain why Australia has winter when the UK has summer, using tilt not distance.

clusters.label: Mentions tilt but cannot connect it to seasons
clusters.why_it_matters: Partial model; needs the mechanism linking tilt to sunlight angle.
quotes: The earth tilts on its axis
Because of the tilt of the earth

reteach.title: Tilt and sunlight angle
steps: Model sunlight angle with a lamp.
reteach.check_question: Why does tilted sunlight feel weaker?

clusters.diagnostic_question: Describe how tilt changes the angle of sunlight hitting a location.

clusters.label: Correct idea, weakly explained
clusters.why_it_matters: Understanding present but fragile; needs articulation practice.
quotes: The earth's tilt changes how much sun we get

reteach.title: Put the mechanism in words
steps: Have students write the causal chain.
reteach.check_question: Write two sentences explaining seasons without using 'closer'.

clusters.diagnostic_question: Write a two-sentence explanation of seasons without the word 'closer'.
